title: Factory Deploy + Verify stages: deploy scripts, verify gate, scheduler integration
verdictText: [VERIFY:FAIL] verdict at deploy: health-running-s1/s2 error = inspect template uses .State.RestartCount (removed from .State in docker v28); ai-hosts-probe timeout = 10s fetch budget vs ~13s cold embedder load (warm re-probe: sushi ok, dim 1024 PASS); gateway-ready speck = sampling-window artifact (logs Ready!, RestartCount 0, running). memory-boot-consistency + logs-classifier PASS.

evidence.impl: [IMPL] P3 closure (commit 0fe80b4, 5 files +149/-27): (1) deploy-config.js actor = resolveActor({...fileEnv, ...env}) — .env DEPLOY_ACTOR honored, process env wins; fileEnv injectable for tests. (2) deploy.js deploySha fresh-host preflight: standalone `test -d $DIR/src/bot.git` probe before the cat-file/fetch compound -> exit 2 host-clone-missing run-build hint, zero cat-file round-trips. (3) verify-deploy.js memory mirror now reads AI_MEMORY_ENABLED + MEMORY_EMBEDDING_DIMENSION via `compose --env-file .deploy-env exec -T bot printenv` through the same DI runner (exit 1 = unset = normal) and applies config.js:457/465 precedence literally: env==="true" OR file strict===true; dim = Number(parseNumber(env) ?? file ?? 1024) || 1024, used by BOTH boot-line and probe compares; non-boolean file value still FAILs only when no env override. (4) embed endpoint = embedder.js hostUrl() parity (memoryEmbeddingHost || vmlxHost verbatim, trailing-slash strip, + /embeddings — port guessing removed), computed host-side by exported embedEndpoint() and baked into probe stdin as `const EMBED_TARGET = <json>`; models port-forcing kept per plan. Tests: deploy 14/14 (new: fresh-host hint, .env actor + precedence), verifyDeploy 21/21 (new: env-true-over-JSON-false PASS, env-dim override both sides, embedEndpoint units, verbatim-host + vmlx-fallback stdin targets; test 9 now asserts printenv cmds + baked EMBED_TARGET). Focused node --test both green; npm test exit 0 once.

got: [REVIEW:APPROVE] Reviewed the deploy/verify diff: the inspect template matched the docker schema in force when written and the probe budgets were reasoned; the VERIFY failures are docker-v28 schema removal, cold-embedder latency and a sampling-window artifact — runtime/environment drift a Review-stage pass could not see. No findings.

title: verify-deploy: docker v28 inspect schema + 30s probe budget + gateway-ready recheck window
verdictText: [REVIEW:CHANGES] (scheduler) QA live run surfaced design flaw in card scope: boot-line checks used fixed --since 2m log window; Ready!/memory lines are one-time boot writes so any verify >2min after startup false-FAILs while health checks showed all services running/0. Fix: memory-boot-consistency + gateway-ready must scope log scans to each container State.StartedAt (from the health inspect JSON, per-service), falling back to 2m when StartedAt unavailable; gateway retry reuses the same window. Tests: fake inspect docs gain StartedAt; assert --since <startedAt> in memory/gateway log commands; live acceptance must run against a stack older than 2 minutes.

title: deploy.js: build must resolve refs under refs/remotes/origin (bare init fetch layout)
verdictText: [QA:FAIL] re-run after VM recovery — host network STILL flapping. Unit (code unchanged at fd8544a): npm test 75/75 exit 0; deploy.test.js 23/23 exit 0. LIVE node scripts/deploy.js build master x2: FAILED at stage 'work reset' (rm -rf work && mkdir -p work), stderr verbatim: "deploy build: work reset failed (code null): spawnSync ssh ETIMEDOUT" exit 1 both times. Windows: 12:36:27->12:37:00 UTC and 12:38:20->12:38:53 UTC; host /tmp/netwatch.log = 25/25 samples net-FAIL lan-FAIL 12:35:40->12:39:41 UTC, zero net-ok — both failure windows fully inside FAIL streak; interactive ssh from QA box succeeds fast (1-2s) meanwhile -> per-connection flapping on host egress path. PROGRESS: failure moved from first round-trip (mkdir src, VM down) to 10th — fetch exit 0 (deploy-key auth OK), compound rev-parse PASSED SHA_RE gate, rev-parse --short=7 OK => card fix live-verified through sha resolution; host clone /opt/discord-bot/src/bot.git refs/remotes/origin/master = 628efcb62349771f922f4232b68625c7fbb86178 == local origin/master. Not yet proven: archive extract, docker build, SHA=/SHORT=/IMAGE= machine lines, sha-628efcb image (docker images grep discord-bot: empty, exit 1). Re-run live QA when netwatch shows sustained net-ok.

evidence.impl: [IMPL] Review bounce #1 fix: 1 commit (fd8544a), 2 files: scripts/deploy.js (--verify added to all THREE compound rev-parse forms — plain rev-parse echoes unresolvable args verbatim to stdout, concatenating missed form names ahead of the winner sha and breaking SHA_RE; --verify suppresses the echo-back, 2>/dev/null + || chain + quoting otherwise byte-identical; code comment corrected), tests/deploy.test.js (test 2 raw-form assertion updated to the --verify bytes; test 21 extended with echo-concatenation block: asserts --verify count==3 in compound cmd + fake fed the exact concatenated stdout the echo produces -> SHA_RE gate rejects it, exit 2, zero downstream cmds). node --test tests/deploy.test.js: 23/23 pass; npm test: 75/75 pass, exit 0.
evidence.context: Harvested from the live board (deploy.js: build must resolve refs under refs/remotes/origin (bare init fetch layout)).

got: [REVIEW:APPROVE] Reviewed the deploy.js --verify rev-parse fix: all three compound forms use --verify, echo-back suppression explained, tests updated to the exact bytes; the QA failure is host-egress network flapping (ssh ETIMEDOUT under a 25/25 net-FAIL streak) which no Review-stage inspection of this diff could catch.
